title: Dae-Won Lee
text:
daewonlee@kias.re.kr · Curriculum vitae
I am a research fellow at the Korea Institute for Advanced Study (KIAS), under the mentorship of Young-Hoon Kiem. I joined KIAS in September 2026. Before joining KIAS, I was a research fellow at Ewha Womans University.
